title: Show the engine run ID in the Overview row and detail
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: ork approve and ork stop take the engine run id (ork-...), but the Overview row shows only the slice and stage, so the owner reads the id from ork status. Until S25 adds keys, show the id on the row or its detail.
